intro-5-2.text: All Wake, this is it. Everything we've got!

after-2-2.text: You came back for it, Mina. That counts.

after-4-1.text: Harrow, Harrow, this is Wake Lead. Commander, do you read me?

ending-sora.text: The Crown is down! Wake Squadron, check in!

brief-sora-2.text: Forty boats came home that night, sir. I counted.

brief-sora-4.text: Understood, Commander. Wake Lead is ready.
